runtime_improvements_implemented: Corrected the pathological 6 GiB soft reclaim target without increasing the 7 GiB hard limit or allowing swap.
Added a read-only status command which checks complete 5 Hz pose rows, file freshness, final metrics and memory pressure, instead of trusting active/success alone.

aperture_diagnostic.scope: 5 selected difficult windows at route distances 39.555, 44.28, 44.46, 44.955 and 45.18 km. Actual recorded sonar/odometry references, 30/60/120 s apertures, identical final PF seed and independent-information caps; no truth deskew or graph loop.
aperture_diagnostic.seed_boundary: Seed is the recorded post-update PF MAP, not the original pre-update cohort prediction. Consequently even the diagnostic 30 s rank can differ from the recorded original rank.
aperture_diagnostic.result: Longer windows sometimes increase numerical rank, but do not consistently decrease position error. Some 120 s windows have worse intensity agreement. Do not apply a universal 120 s replacement based on these examples.

wider_candidate_diagnostic.scope: Same 5 end times and 30 s data, using the existing deterministic raw-likelihood proposal refiner before local Gaussian approximation. Diagnostic modes have NOT been admitted to PF/GTSAM.
wider_candidate_diagnostic.interpretation: Some apparent low-rank failures arise near an inadequately refined local mode, not solely from intrinsically flat terrain. A wider recovery proposal is worth controlled testing; a stronger local fit does not by itself prove global uniqueness or authorize a correction.

output_source_diagnostic.scope: 1019 independent-window timestamps through simulated time 30570 s, NOT full-rate full-route RMSE. Predetermined counterfactual uses confirmed ordinary PF for one cohort, otherwise keeps recorded output. No truth-dependent source selection, no soft-output transients or future proposal feedback simulated.
output_source_diagnostic.interpretation: Changing output arbitration alone gives only a small diagnostic improvement and leaves the worst peaks. It is not the preferred first algorithm change and has not been deployed.

next_algorithm_experiment.priority: Better raw-sonar recovery candidate generation when ordinary tracking has lost a usable mode.
safety_requirements: Keep the current validated algorithm and original 72 km frozen version separately reproducible.
Treat a recovered distant mode as a new hypothesis rather than silently moving a persistent cohort identity.
Preserve null/alias alternatives and require the existing independent-window confirmation before publication or graph authorization.
Audit proposal deduplication so it cannot discard a genuinely better nearby raw mode merely due to persistent-ID preference.
Test same inputs/seeds first, then native front/back integration and full-route regression; include false-alias controls.
Do not infer closed-loop long-range improvement from the selected-window diagnostics above.
